shots.onScreen: Black, almost empty. Small UI fragments and a wordmark, then a dark road plate with a headline over it.
shots.moves: Fragments assemble in a near-empty frame. Peak 28.2 is the plate arriving under the type.

shots.onScreen: A person to camera, then a hard RED wash over the same frame, then an abstract dark field with cursors.
shots.moves: The colour grade itself changes mid-shot. Peak 55.9, the loudest frame in the whole store, is that wash.

shots.onScreen: A dark field with a glowing orange curve drawing across it, and a two-word headline.
shots.moves: The curve DRAWS. It is the only line-art motion in the film.
shots.trigger: Hard cut to a light card.

shots.onScreen: Cream. A black disc, then chat bubbles stacking inside it, then a white bloom.
shots.moves: Bubbles stack one at a time, the clearest 'evidence' beat in the film.
shots.trigger: Hard blow-out to white, into the speaker.

shots.onScreen: The speaker under a GREEN grade, captions arriving word by word.
shots.moves: Captions only. The footage runs; the grade holds.
shots.trigger: Hard cut to a light graphic card.

shots.onScreen: Cream. A shadowed object, a rising chart, and a headline where two words are heavy italic.
shots.moves: The chart rises and the shadow sweeps. Peak 22.9 is that sweep.
shots.trigger: Hard cut back to the speaker.

shots.onScreen: The speaker under RED, then neutral, then BLUE, then a white bloom, captions throughout.
shots.moves: The grade cycles through three colours inside one shot while the captions continue.

shots.onScreen: The speaker, then the frame shrinking into a phone-shaped card with a year on it.
shots.moves: The frame itself becomes an object: the video is placed inside a card at the end.
shots.trigger: Nothing: it ends on the card.

groundPattern: dark → dark → dark → light → dark → light → mid? → dark
threads: THE CAPTION LINE. A word-by-word caption runs across every talking-head beat and continues the sentence the graphic beats interrupt, so the argument never stops even when the picture leaves the speaker entirely.
spectacle: 7.87s, peak 55.9: a hard red wash drops over the speaker's face mid-sentence. It is the loudest single frame in this entire store, and it lasts a few frames.
takeaway:
GRADE AS PUNCTUATION. This film cuts by CHANGING THE COLOUR OF THE SAME FOOTAGE: red, green, blue, neutral, white blow-out, sometimes twice inside one shot. It needs no cut to change register, and the technique costs one filter.
IT ALTERNATES CLAIM AND FIGURE. Speaker beats carry the sentence; graphic beats (a drawing curve, stacking chat bubbles, a rising chart) carry the evidence. Neither runs more than about 4s before the other returns.
ITS PEAKS ARE ALL GRADES OR BLOOMS, never motion: 55.9, 28.2, 22.9. A film can be measured as extremely active while nothing in it actually travels.
about: A talking-head social video under a heavy motion-graphics overlay. Pinterest pin 933230354045109691.
